changelog:
Initial release of shanghai-service-guide skill:

- Provides detailed guidance for users navigating Shanghai government service questions, leveraging public "一网通办" data.
- Maps user needs to municipal departments, service items, and online/offline options for both individuals and organizations.
- Supplies clear next steps, department info, and official URLs for verification.
- Handles ambiguous or incomplete requests by asking clarifying questions or providing low-confidence suggestions.
- Ensures practical, reliable, and always-verifiable recommendations for government services in Shanghai.
summary: Help users with Shanghai government service questions using public Shanghai "一网通办" service-guide data. Use when the user asks about 上海办事, 一网通办, 办事指南, 去哪办, 哪个...
